data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021 were GBP 379.4m. The report shows no material aggregate prior-year reserve movement for years prior to 2021 (calculated as GBP 0.0m from the gross claims development table), i.e. broadly flat prior-year development. The managing agent notes a small improvement in the 2019 closed year result (GBP 0.3m profit) but overall prior-year reserves show no significant strengthening or release. Current year results were adversely affected by 2021 catastrophe events (Hurricane Ida, European Floods, Winterstorm Uri), which are separate to prior-year development.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary sources used: Note 3 technical provisions (opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2021 = GBP 379.4m) and the gross claims development table (used to calculate prior-year development = GBP 0.0m). Chairman's statement provided headline gross written premium (GBP 380m) but the statements and notes show a reported gross premium of GBP 255.9m in the financial statements; the financial-statement figure (255.9) was used. Some segmental tables in the PDF were partially parsed; where precise LOB movements or per-LOB prior-year reserve movements were not explicitly quantified, amounts left null. The prior-year development amount is calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 101); narrative statements about a small closed-year profit (+GBP 0.3m) were noted but are not equivalent to gross PY reserve movement and were not used as the primary numeric source.
